question: 一共有多少个院系？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM departments

question: 计算机学院在哪栋楼？
gold_sql: SELECT building FROM departments WHERE name = '计算机学院'

question: 每个院系有多少个专业？
gold_sql: SELECT d.name AS dept, COUNT(*) AS n FROM majors m JOIN departments d ON m.dept_id = d.id GROUP BY d.name

question: 软件工程专业属于哪个院系？
gold_sql: SELECT d.name AS dept FROM majors m JOIN departments d ON m.dept_id = d.id WHERE m.name = '软件工程'

question: 一共有多少名学生？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM students

question: GPA最高的学生叫什么名字？
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM students ORDER BY gpa DESC LIMIT 1

question: 每个年级分别有多少名学生？
gold_sql: SELECT grade, COUNT(*) AS n FROM students GROUP BY grade ORDER BY grade

question: 2023级的学生有多少人？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM students WHERE grade = 2023

question: GPA超过3.5的学生有多少人？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM students WHERE gpa > 3.5

question: 一共有多少名教师？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM teachers

question: 每个院系有多少名教师？
gold_sql: SELECT d.name AS dept, COUNT(*) AS n FROM teachers t JOIN departments d ON t.dept_id = d.id GROUP BY d.name

question: 职称为教授的教师有多少名？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM teachers WHERE title = '教授'

question: 一共有多少门课程？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM courses

question: 学分大于等于4的课程有哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM courses WHERE credits >= 4

question: 每位教师讲授的课程数量是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT t.name AS teacher, COUNT(c.id) AS n FROM courses c JOIN teachers t ON c.teacher_id = t.id GROUP BY t.name

question: 数据库原理这门课有多少学分？
gold_sql: SELECT credits FROM courses WHERE name = '数据库原理'

question: 每栋楼有多少间教室？
gold_sql: SELECT building, COUNT(*) AS n FROM classrooms GROUP BY building

question: 容量最大的教室能坐多少人？
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(capacity) AS cap FROM classrooms

question: 星期一有哪些教室被排了课？
gold_sql: SELECT cr.building, cr.room_no FROM schedules s JOIN classrooms cr ON s.classroom_id = cr.id WHERE s.week_day = 1

question: 每间教室各排了多少节课？
gold_sql: SELECT cr.building, cr.room_no, COUNT(*) AS n FROM schedules s JOIN classrooms cr ON s.classroom_id = cr.id GROUP BY cr.building, cr.room_no

question: 星期三第2节有什么课？
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM schedules s JOIN courses c ON s.course_id = c.id WHERE s.week_day = 3 AND s.slot = 2

question: 2026春学期一共有多少条选课记录？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM enrollments WHERE semester = '2026春'

question: 每门课程的平均成绩是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS course, AVG(e.score) AS avg_score FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name

question: 有多少条不及格的选课记录？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM enrollments WHERE score < 60

question: 学生陈志远的平均分是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(e.score) AS avg_score FROM enrollments e JOIN students s ON e.student_id = s.id WHERE s.name = '陈志远'

question: 选课人数最多的课程是哪门？
gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS course, COUNT(*) AS n FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

question: 国家奖学金的金额是多少元？
gold_sql: SELECT amount FROM scholarships WHERE name = '国家奖学金'

question: 2025年获得奖学金的学生有多少人？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS n FROM scholarship_awards WHERE year = 2025

question: 获得奖学金次数最多的学生叫什么名字？
gold_sql: SELECT s.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_awards a JOIN students s ON a.student_id = s.id GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

question: 金额最高的奖学金是多少元？
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(amount) AS m FROM scholarships

question: 一共有几栋宿舍楼？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM dormitories

question: 每栋宿舍楼有多少个房间？
gold_sql: SELECT d.building, COUNT(r.id) AS n FROM dorm_rooms r JOIN dormitories d ON r.dormitory_id = d.id GROUP BY d.building

question: 宿舍房间的总床位容量是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(capacity) AS total FROM dorm_rooms

question: 一共有多少个社团？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM clubs

question: 每种类别的社团有多少个？
gold_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS n FROM clubs GROUP BY category

question: 哪个社团的成员最多？
gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS club, COUNT(*) AS n FROM club_members m JOIN clubs c ON m.club_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

question: 担任社长的学生都叫什么名字？
gold_sql: SELECT s.name FROM club_members m JOIN students s ON m.student_id = s.id WHERE m.role = '社长'

question: 文艺类社团有哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM clubs WHERE category = '文艺'

question: 参加社团的学生共有多少人？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS n FROM club_members

question: 没有参加任何社团的学生有多少人？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM students WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT student_id FROM club_members)

question: 住宿的学生共有多少人？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS n FROM dorm_assignments

question: 每个学院的学生人数是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT d.name AS dept, COUNT(*) AS n FROM students s JOIN majors m ON s.major_id = m.id JOIN departments d ON m.dept_id = d.id GROUP BY d.name

question: 平均GPA最高的院系是哪个？
gold_sql: SELECT d.name AS dept FROM students s JOIN majors m ON s.major_id = m.id JOIN departments d ON m.dept_id = d.id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY AVG(s.gpa) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 选了数据库原理这门课的学生有多少人？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON e.course_id = c.id WHERE c.name = '数据库原理'

question: 每个学期分别有多少条选课记录？
gold_sql: SELECT semester, COUNT(*) AS n FROM enrollments GROUP BY semester ORDER BY semester

question: 2025秋学期有不及格记录的课程有几门？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT course_id) AS n FROM enrollments WHERE semester = '2025秋' AND score < 60

question: 获得国家奖学金的学生的平均GPA是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(s.gpa) AS avg_gpa FROM scholarship_awards a JOIN scholarships sc ON a.scholarship_id = sc.id JOIN students s ON a.student_id = s.id WHERE sc.name = '国家奖学金'

question: 住在A栋宿舍的学生有多少人？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.student_id) AS n FROM dorm_assignments a JOIN dorm_rooms r ON a.room_id = r.id JOIN dormitories d ON r.dormitory_id = d.id WHERE d.building = 'A栋宿舍'
